verdict.rationale: No documented export feature appears in the evidence. Portability is only implied: Gitea is self-hosted on your own servers (gitea-docs-23, gitea-docs-9), stores data in standard databases like SQLite, MySQL and PostgreSQL (gitea-docs-14), and offers an API for programmatic access (gitea-docs-4). A community report that backup/restore is still weak (gitea-comm-20) suggests a full data exit is not smooth. Missing for 10: a documented full-data export (issues, PRs, wiki, users) in open formats, a first-party exit/migration-out guide, and hands-on corroboration that leaving works cleanly.
